chapter_title: Concerning the Five Things that he constructed with the hard Bodies of the Rulers
chapter_note: A very brief, mostly substrate-style enumerative teaching: a fivefold construction list attributed to the Living Spirit, describing cosmic architecture (Porter, pillar, great sea, vessels) without moral/pastoral application. Only the opening dialogue-attribution formula is later framing.

paragraphs.core_text: The Living Spirit constructed five great things from veins and skull[s in the] hard [bodies].
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed hagiographic/dialogue frame attribution: “Once again the enlightener speaks:” (Layer-2 editorial container).
paragraphs.temporal_note: Opening formula ‘Once again the enlightener speaks’ is a classic compilation frame; the remaining sentence is impersonal cosmological construction-teaching (fivefold structure; cosmos→cosmos).

paragraphs.core_text: The first is the disc that is placed upon [the sh]oulder of the Porter.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Enumerative, impersonal architectural mapping within the cosmic system (disc ↔ Porter), no institutional or exhortative reach.

paragraphs.core_text: The se[con]d are the arches of [the] pillar that is before him.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Continues the fivefold cosmic-construction list in the same systematic register; no frame/citation/application voice.

paragraphs.core_text: [The th]ird is the [mou]ld of the fo[r]m for the gehennas.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Still internal cosmographic/eschatological architecture (forms/gehennas) presented as part of the construction sequence.

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth are the [seven (?)] pillars that he has erected in the great sea, in [the] seven parts of the universe.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Numbered cosmic correspondential structuring (‘seven pillars… seven parts of the universe’) in an expository voice characteristic of the teaching substrate.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth are the four walls that surround the vessels.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Concludes the impersonal five-item construction schema; the ‘four walls’ fits degree/numbered cosmology rather than later pastoral application.
